- "Property tax"

- "Estimate"

- "Save a copy ... what goes in the file" (what file, and where does it go?)

- "There is no Send button on this page" is reassuring, but it also made me wonder whether something might be sent.
- I don't have my loan papers handy, so I might type the wrong thing.
- There are many boxes, and I don't know which ones I must fill in. Only some say optional.
- "Save a copy" puts a file on my phone, and I don't know where it goes.
- I worry the answer isn't real, since it says it's only a close guess.

- The "15 years / 20 years / 30 years" buttons if I already know my number, though they might save typing.
- The "Print" and "Save a copy" buttons, since they're faded and I haven't got an answer yet.
